title: Dill Pickle Deviled Eggs
summary: Eggs are hard-cooked off the heat, yolks sieved and mixed with mayonnaise, soured cream, pickle brine, mustard powder, a little sugar, chopped pickles and dill, then spooned back and topped with dill sprigs.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Bring the eggs to a boil, cover and leave off the heat 12 minutes.

steps.title: Sieve
steps.text: Press the yolks through a sieve for a silky filling.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir in the mayonnaise, soured cream, brine, mustard powder, sugar, pepper, pickles and dill.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Fill the whites and top with dill sprigs.

tips: Chop the pickles very finely so they pipe.
Taste before adding salt; the brine usually seasons it enough.
Older eggs peel more easily than very fresh ones.
storage: Refrigerate covered and eat within 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
